New to aviation gifts?

Our checklist explains personal preferences, compatibility and other details worth checking.

Read the checklist →
  1. Find the personal connection. Their first airplane, favorite airshow, or an item they actually asked for.
  2. Check the fit. Aircraft plugs, tablet models, clothing sizes and shelf space all matter.
  3. Check the delivered total. Include tax and shipping, then read the delivery estimate and return terms.
  4. Keep technical gifts collaborative. For headsets and cockpit equipment, let the pilot choose the exact version.
